review.conclusion_reason: YES lacks a positive source establishing any EO 12936 command operating on 2026-10-14. The historical Code-note listing and 2018 parent amendment do not resolve the admitted parent and provision-survival gaps. OPEN is warranted pending current parent status and provision-specific continuity evidence in the current Manual and intervening amendments, plus section 5 performance evidence in congressional records. Formal status is supportable only as no express ending found in the checked sources, separately from operative status.
missed_evidence: The directly read Code note describes amendments as having been contained in the listed orders; that historical formulation limits its use as affirmative current-status evidence. Location: https://www.law.cornell.edu/uscode/text/10/801, lines 1874-1912.

EO 13825 sections 2(c) and 5(c) preserve specified earlier proceedings, including proceedings conducted as if the amendments had not been prescribed. Any replacement analysis must account for these savings provisions. Location: jobs/fr-originals/output/texts/EO_13825.txt, PDF pages 1-2.
review.stop_code_verdict: confirmed: HELD_UNROUTED fits the first gap because named held amendment texts remain available for provision-level comparison; the evidence slice supplies intermediate acting texts, and the cited EO_13825.txt is present. This does not imply those files alone would close the entire gap.
review.suspected_defect: The YES conclusion appears substituted for OPEN: every listed clause remains open, and the worker expressly admits missing parent-status and provision-survival findings. Historical citations were promoted into cutoff-date proof without supporting evidence.

Section 1 expressly amends Part II; the cited OCR year error is present.

Held text at lines 297-298 expressly amends Part IV.
Section 4 states the December 9, 1994 effective date and contains applicability and savings provisions, without expiry.
Section 5 directs the Secretary of Defense to transmit a copy to Congress. It does not establish performance.

EO 13825's preamble and amendment provisions confirm continued use of the EO 12473 Manual in 2018. This does not establish the survival of a particular 1994 command at the cutoff.

EO 13825 section 1 amends Parts II-IV through Annex 1, and section 4 makes further amendments through Annex 2. Provision-specific replacement is properly characterized as a candidate requiring comparison.
Directly opened the cited LII page: line 1912 contains the quoted EO 12936 entry. This confirms historical inclusion, not current operation.
The cited page at lines 1873-1923 confirms the heading, newest listed 2024 entry, and absence of a revocation statement in that list. Its historical wording does not certify continued operation.
